title: Bhavitha Mandava Wins Instagram Rings Award After Subway Discovery Led to Chanel First
excerpt: The Hyderabad-born former architecture student, the first Indian model to open a Chanel show, is one of 25 global creators honoured in Instagram's Rings Award 2026.
body:
• Hyderabad-born model Bhavitha Mandava, 26, has been named one of 25 global winners of the Instagram Rings Award 2026, one of two Indian winners alongside Kerala freestyle footballer Muhammed Riswan.
  • Mandava was discovered on a New York subway platform in 2024 by Matthieu Blazy while studying in the city, with no prior modelling experience, and debuted exclusively for Bottega Veneta.
  • In December 2025 she became the first Indian model to open Chanel's Metiers d'Art show, and in March 2026 she became a Chanel House Ambassador.
  • Winners receive a physical ring with a four-leaf clover crafted from Connemara marble and digital profile customisation privileges.

Bhavitha Mandava, the Hyderabad-born architecture graduate who was discovered on a New York subway platform, has been named one of the 25 global winners of the Instagram Rings Award 2026. Instagram cited her journey from student in New York to international runway model, according to News Ei Samay. She is one of two Indian winners this year, alongside Kerala-based freestyle footballer Muhammed Riswan.

From architecture classrooms to the runway

Mandava was born into a Telugu family in Andhra Pradesh and raised in Hyderabad. She studied architecture at Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, then moved to New York for a Master of Science in Integrated Design and Media, focused on Human-Computer Interaction, Y This News reported. Modelling was not part of the plan, and she remains a licensed architect.

https://x.com/thebetterindia/status/2116074301023821829

In 2024, Matthieu Blazy, then creative director of Bottega Veneta, spotted her on a subway platform, where she was wearing jeans and a T-shirt. She walked exclusively for Bottega Veneta's Spring/Summer 2025 show in Milan and featured in the brand's campaign. The Global Indian account of her rise describes her balancing classes, a morning job and weekend modelling flights to Europe before graduating from New York University.

"Somehow, the extraordinary found me."

- Bhavitha Mandava

A first for India at Chanel

In December 2025, Mandava opened Chanel's Metiers d'Art show in New York, becoming the first Indian model to open a Chanel runway show. The show was staged on a set resembling a subway platform, echoing the place where she had been scouted. In March 2026, Chanel named her a House Ambassador, a first for an Indian model. She has since appeared on the covers of British Vogue and Numero France, made a Met Gala debut, and built an Instagram following of about 740,000.

What the Rings award recognises

The Instagram Rings Awards, launched in October 2025, honour 25 creators worldwide for originality, creativity and impact rather than follower count. Instagram said Mandava's content offers an insider's view of fashion, combining backstage material with her training in design. All 25 winners receive a physical ring featuring a four-leaf clover crafted from Connemara marble, plus the ability to customise the background colour of their Instagram profiles.

Why her story travels

For Indian students abroad, Mandava's path carries a specific resonance: she arrived in New York on a student visa with a large education loan, and the subway discovery that changed her career began, by her own accounts, on an ordinary commute during her master's degree. Her parents' emotional reaction to her Chanel opening, filmed as they watched from home, circulated widely online. The Rings award adds a creator-economy honour to a fashion record that, two years after she left India for the first time, already includes two of the industry's most closely watched houses.
